question: Do the stable construction-specific upstream coordinates transfer through the native live layer-15 attention computation, or only relative to the complete attention-15 donor background?

searched: temporal/iswas construction-oracle, bisector, fixed-projector, and attention15 path-audit results
two-factor dependency and Mobius factorial priors, contracts, and runners
prior_art.known_lessons: A1/A2 oracle axes are individually stable and effective but construction-specific and nonselective on one P parity. Their distinct writes produce aligned responses at every L15H5 Q/K/Q2/K2/V interface, while all existing behavioral evaluations bypass live attention 15.
prior_art.novelty: Execute each fixed construction oracle with attention 15 live and complete in an exact no-refit dependency factorial, separating native upstream transfer, the attention-15 main effect, and their interaction.

frozen_design.projectors: For each evaluation parity, use the corresponding construction oracle trained on the opposite parity. No refit, mixture, dimension change, or outcome-selected orientation.

cells.00: no upstream projector; live native attention 15
cells.01: no upstream projector; complete attention-15 donor clamp
cells.10: construction oracle installed; live native attention 15
cells.11: construction oracle installed; complete attention-15 donor clamp

frozen_design.linear_accounting: Apply exact rowwise margin Mobius accounting separately by expert, parity, panel, and version. Score upstream-live=r10-r00 against the registered donor-minus-base target. Report KL/flips separately by cell without nonlinear decomposition.
frozen_design.parent_replay: Cell 11 must exactly replay each construction-oracle parent report on v15 and v16. Cell 00 must replay the native manual base.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_parent_replay: All hashes, alignments, cell-11 parent replays, cell-00 base replay, row coverage, factorial closure, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_each_oracle_transfers_own_v15_tar: For both evaluation parities, A1-oracle upstream-live reaches A1 signed projection >= .65 and direction fraction >= .875, and A2-oracle upstream-live does the same on A2.
predictions.pred_c_live_attention_retains_most_fixed: For each expert and parity on its own v15 target, arm-10 signed projection is at least 75% of arm-11 signed projection.
predictions.pred_d_attention15_dependency_interactio: For each expert/parity own v15 target, the mean absolute Mobius interaction is at most 25% of the mean absolute arm-11 margin response.
predictions.pred_e_live_attention_does_not_worsen_co: For every v15 P/C expert-parity cell, arm 10 has no more top-one flips and no larger mean KL than arm 11.
predictions.pred_f_v16_new_intervention_retains_fixe: For A1-oracle on v16 A1 and A2-oracle on v16 A2, arm 10 retains at least 75% of arm 11 signed projection with direction fraction >= .875 in both parities and no more P flips. This is OOD_TEXT_REUSE_NEW_INTERVENTION.

decision: B/C passing establishes a native live-attention route and licenses a separate L15H5-specific Q/K/V reset/rescue. B/C failure rejects the weight-reader causal route under these interventions and attributes prior transfer to the fixed attention-15 background. E is required for selective-circuit promotion but not for path localization; D distinguishes mostly additive transmission from a conditional attention gate.
